insights.deepseek_advice: For charts claiming to show 'real-terms' economic data by political leader, always query both the specific figures AND the methodology (real vs nominal vs PPP) — the most common source of error is using current US dollar figures that inflate/deflate with exchange rates rather than true purchasing-power-parity measures. Also flag when a chart visibly stops before a politically significant data point (here: Thatcher), as selective truncation is a common misleading framing technique.
